## Progress

- Merged [PR #665](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/665): /settings with Profile, Locations (sites, rooms and resources), Hours (operating hours with weekday toggles, plus the bookable-schedule editor) and Holidays tabs; `/v1/settings/*` needs practice configuration (Config on Staff, roles, integrations), every other role gets 403 from the server (mutation-checked); a holiday refuses holds, bookings, reschedules and walk-in slots on that date through the booking path (mutation-checked), shows the day as Closed and lists booked visits to move; each change keeps before/after (SettingsChange) and a settings.* audit event in one transaction; logo checked by file signature (PNG/JPEG) and size 512 KB, stored in private Blob under a random key, shown through a 5-minute signed link; EN/HI/AR, RTL, axe clean, browser-verified against the real API and Azurite
- Left: malware scan of the logo (no scanner in the repo; Defender for Storage with MDV-P0-006); settings are built on the seeded tenants, creating them is MDV-P1-004; Notifications/Data tabs MDV-P1-006, Doctors/Staff MDV-P1-007/008

## Description

/settings with tabs: Profile (clinic name, logo "Shown on prescriptions, invoices and the patient portal", address, registration numbers, contact), Locations (multiple sites, rooms/resources such as procedure room), Hours (operating hours per location, weekday toggles), Holidays (closures; booking blocked). Notifications and Data tabs are MDV-P1-006; Doctors/Staff tabs are MDV-P1-007/008; Services is P4.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Owners/admins can edit profile and locations; other roles get 403 (server-side).
- [ ] **AC2.** A holiday blocks new bookings on that date for the location and lists existing appointments that need moving.
- [ ] **AC3.** Logo upload is validated (type, size), malware-scanned, stored in private Blob and served via time-limited link.
- [ ] **AC4.** Every settings change is written to the audit log with before/after (no PHI involved).
- [ ] **AC5.** Settings work in English/Hindi/Arabic with RTL.
